qex_zlp_air_view_01.explanation: View #1. Make clear: unique searcher hay lượt search? (biz nói "bao nhiêu người" → unique, nhưng confirm). Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_01.question: Mỗi ngày bao nhiêu người tìm vé? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_01.sql:
SELECT search_date,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_searcher,
       COUNT(*)                AS search_cnt
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_02.explanation: View #2. Make clear: đếm theo departure_date (ngày muốn bay) — KHÁC #1; có giới hạn search_date không (vd chỉ search trong tháng 2)? Note: demand curve forward-looking
qex_zlp_air_view_02.question: Nhu cầu bay dồn vào ngày nào? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_02.sql:
SELECT departure_date, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_searcher
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_03.explanation: View #3. Make clear: lượt search hay unique searcher per giờ? Giờ theo activity_time (local). Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_03.question: User search giờ nào trong ngày? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_03.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM activity_time) AS hr,
       COUNT(*) AS search_cnt
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_04.explanation: View #4. Make clear: #4 dùng search_day_in_week, #5 dùng departure_day_in_week — biz hay lẫn 2 cái, hỏi rõ "thứ user bấm tìm" hay "thứ user muốn bay". Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_04.question: Search rơi vào thứ nào? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_04.sql:
SELECT search_day_in_week AS dow,            -- #5: thay bằng departure_day_in_week
       COUNT(*) AS search_cnt
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE search_day_in_week WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END;

qex_zlp_air_view_05.explanation: View #5. Make clear: #4 dùng search_day_in_week, #5 dùng departure_day_in_week — biz hay lẫn 2 cái, hỏi rõ "thứ user bấm tìm" hay "thứ user muốn bay". Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_05.question: Muốn bay vào thứ nào? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_05.sql:
SELECT search_day_in_week AS dow,            -- #5: thay bằng departure_day_in_week
       COUNT(*) AS search_cnt
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE search_day_in_week WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6 WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END;

qex_zlp_air_view_06.explanation: View #6. Make clear: Top N? Tách chiều hay gộp 2 chiều (→ #28)? Theo airport hay city (→ #27)? Lượt search (frequency) hay unique searcher? — đưa cả 2 cột đối chiếu, rank lệch nhau = route bị "soi giá" lặp. Note: hỏi biz: top N? gộp 2 chiều?
qex_zlp_air_view_06.question: Top route được tìm nhiều nhất? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_06.sql:
SELECT route,
       COUNT(*)                AS search_cnt,
       COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_searcher,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_share
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT {{ top_n }};

qex_zlp_air_view_07.explanation: View #7. Make clear: dest gồm cả sân bay quốc tế (440 code) — chỉ domestic? Gom theo city? Note: dest có 440 code, gồm intl
qex_zlp_air_view_07.question: Top điểm đến hot? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_07.sql:
SELECT dest, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS unique_searcher
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT {{ top_n }};

qex_zlp_air_view_08.explanation: View #8. Make clear: theo lượt search hay theo user (1 user có thể search cả 2 loại → user-level tổng >100%)? Note: One-way ~83% baseline
qex_zlp_air_view_08.question: Tỷ lệ tìm 1 chiều vs khứ hồi?
qex_zlp_air_view_08.sql:
SELECT trip_type,
       COUNT(*) AS search_cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_09.explanation: View #9. Make clear: đây là intent lúc search (user_search_group), khác hành vi lúc mua (#18) — biz muốn cái nào? Note: loại 75 dòng Unknown
qex_zlp_air_view_09.question: User định đặt sớm hay sát ngày?
qex_zlp_air_view_09.sql:
SELECT user_search_group,
       COUNT(*) AS search_cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
  AND user_search_group <> 'Unknown'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE user_search_group WHEN 'Same day' THEN 0 WHEN '1-3 days' THEN 1 WHEN '4-7 days' THEN 2
  WHEN '8-14 days' THEN 3 WHEN '15-30 days' THEN 4 WHEN '31-60 days' THEN 5 WHEN '>60 days' THEN 6 END;

qex_zlp_air_view_10.explanation: View #10. Make clear: theo ngày mua reqDate (không phải ngày bay); có cắt theo provider không? Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_10.question: Mỗi ngày bao nhiêu đơn / khách mua? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_10.sql:
SELECT date(reqDate) AS pay_date,
       COUNT(transID)         AS txn,
       COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS paying_user
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_11.explanation: View #11. Make clear: TPV gross (chưa refund) — biz có đang kỳ vọng doanh thu thực không? Nói rõ ngay. Note: gross, chưa có refund
qex_zlp_air_view_11.question: TPV theo ngày/tháng?
qex_zlp_air_view_11.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', reqDate) AS ym,   -- daily: date(reqDate)
       SUM(amount) AS tpv
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_12.explanation: View #12. Make clear: trục thời gian là flight_date; vẫn nên giới hạn thêm range mua (reqDate) nếu biz hỏi "vé Tết đã bán". Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_12.question: Đơn dồn vào ngày bay nào? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_12.sql:
SELECT flight_date, COUNT(transID) AS txn
FROM payment_air
WHERE flight_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_13.explanation: View #13. Make clear: giờ/thứ theo reqDate. Cắt provider? Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_13.question: Mua vé giờ nào, thứ nào? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_13.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM reqDate) AS hr,     -- theo thứ: format_datetime(reqDate, 'EEEE') AS dow
       COUNT(transID) AS txn
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_14.explanation: View #14. Make clear: như #6 (top N, chiều, airport/city) + rank theo transaction hay paying user — 2 bảng xếp hạng có thể khác nhau, đưa cả 2 cột. Note: —
qex_zlp_air_view_14.question: Top route thực mua? ✅
qex_zlp_air_view_14.sql:
SELECT route,
       COUNT(transID)         AS txn,
       COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS paying_user,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(transID) / SUM(COUNT(transID)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_txn
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT {{ top_n }};

qex_zlp_air_view_15.explanation: View #15. Make clear: "theo hãng" hay "theo provider/appID"? EnViet gom Bamboo/Vietravel/Sun PQ → nếu biz muốn theo hãng thật thì phần EnViet KHÔNG tách được, phải khai báo. Share theo transaction hay TPV? Note: ⚠ EnViet = third party gom Bamboo/Vietravel/Sun PQ → "theo hãng" ≠ "theo appUser", hỏi biz cắt theo gì
qex_zlp_air_view_15.question: Thị phần các hãng/provider?
qex_zlp_air_view_15.sql:
SELECT appID, appUser,
       MAX(CASE WHEN flight_type = 'DOMESTIC' THEN 'DOM' ELSE 'INTL' END) AS dom_intl,
       COUNT(transID) AS txn,
       SUM(amount)    AS tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(transID) / SUM(COUNT(transID)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_txn,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount)    / SUM(SUM(amount))    OVER (), 2) AS pct_tpv
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY txn DESC;

qex_zlp_air_view_16.question: Domestic vs International chiếm bao nhiêu?
qex_zlp_air_view_16.sql:
SELECT flight_type, COUNT(transID) AS txn, SUM(amount) AS tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(transID) / SUM(COUNT(transID)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_txn
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_17.explanation: View #17. Make clear: không có gì phải hỏi thêm — nhưng bắt buộc UPPER(), nếu không sẽ ra 4 dòng thay vì 2. Note: bắt buộc UPPER() trước khi group (lẫn case ở data T12/2024–T1/2025)
qex_zlp_air_view_17.question: Mua 1 chiều hay khứ hồi?
qex_zlp_air_view_17.sql:
SELECT CASE UPPER(round_type) WHEN 'ONEWAY' THEN 'OneWay' ELSE 'RoundTrip' END AS round_type_norm,
       COUNT(transID) AS txn,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(transID) / SUM(COUNT(transID)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_18.explanation: View #18. Make clear: behavior lúc mua (booking_window_group) — đối chiếu intent lúc search là #9/#33. Note: bucket chuẩn: Same day → >60 days
qex_zlp_air_view_18.question: Khách mua sớm hay sát ngày bay?
qex_zlp_air_view_18.sql:
SELECT booking_window_group,
       COUNT(transID) AS txn,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(transID) / SUM(COUNT(transID)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE booking_window_group WHEN 'Same day' THEN 0 WHEN '1-3 days' THEN 1 WHEN '4-7 days' THEN 2
  WHEN '8-14 days' THEN 3 WHEN '15-30 days' THEN 4 WHEN '31-60 days' THEN 5 WHEN '>60 days' THEN 6 END;

concepts: AOV = TPV/transaction, payment_air, theo month(reqDate), grain = dimension chọn
qex_zlp_air_view_19.explanation: View #19. Make clear: biz nói "giá vé trung bình" → hỏi ngay: per đơn (AOV) hay per vé (ATP)? ATP không tính được (thiếu ticket_num) — chốt AOV và nói rõ 1 đơn có thể nhiều vé. KHÔNG dùng AOV trả lời góc per-user (đó là ARPPU, #39). Spec: AOV = TPV/transaction, payment_air, theo month(reqDate), grain = dimension chọn Note: AOV per đơn, không phải per vé (thiếu ticket_num → không tính được ATP) và không dùng cho góc per-user
qex_zlp_air_view_19.question: Giá trị đơn trung bình (AOV) theo tháng / hãng / route / DOM-INTL?
qex_zlp_air_view_19.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', reqDate) AS ym,   -- đổi grain: appID / route / flight_type
       CAST(SUM(amount) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(transID) AS aov,   -- CAST tránh chia nguyên
       COUNT(transID) AS txn
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_20.explanation: View #20. Make clear: biz cần percentile hay danh sách đơn to bất thường để check? Ngưỡng outlier bao nhiêu? Spec: histogram/percentile amount, payment_air, range reqDate Note: range 592K–48.8M; p50/p90/p99 + outlier review
qex_zlp_air_view_20.question: Phân phối giá trị đơn? Đơn to bất thường?
qex_zlp_air_view_20.sql:
SELECT approx_percentile(amount, 0.5)  AS p50,
       approx_percentile(amount, 0.9)  AS p90,
       approx_percentile(amount, 0.99) AS p99,
       MIN(amount) AS min_amt, MAX(amount) AS max_amt
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY;
-- list outlier: SELECT * FROM payment_air WHERE amount > {{ threshold }} ORDER BY amount DESC;

concepts: median + phân phối booking_window, grain route / appUser / UPPER(round_type)
qex_zlp_air_view_21.explanation: View #21. Make clear: so bằng median (mặc định, chống outlier) hay mean? Dimension nào trước? Spec: median + phân phối booking_window, grain route / appUser / UPPER(round_type) Note: RoundTrip & intl kỳ vọng đặt sớm hơn
qex_zlp_air_view_21.question: Booking window khác nhau thế nào giữa các route / hãng / 1 chiều–khứ hồi?
qex_zlp_air_view_21.sql:
SELECT route,                                 -- đổi: appID / UPPER(round_type) / flight_type
       COUNT(transID) AS txn,
       approx_percentile(booking_window, 0.5) AS median_bw,
       AVG(booking_window) AS avg_bw
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(transID) >= 30        -- đủ mẫu mới so
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

concepts: transaction theo days-to-Tết, so Tết 2026 vs Tết 2025, × provider
qex_zlp_air_view_22.explanation: View #22. Make clear: mốc Tết = mùng 1 (Tết 2025: 2025-01-29; Tết 2026: 2026-02-17)? Window countdown ±bao nhiêu ngày? So transaction hay TPV? Spec: transaction theo days-to-Tết, so Tết 2026 vs Tết 2025, × provider Note: view sẵn: Overview Countdown + theo hãng
qex_zlp_air_view_22.question: Càng gần Tết hành vi đặt vé đổi ra sao? ✅ (Countdown)
qex_zlp_air_view_22.sql:
SELECT season, days_to_tet, COUNT(transID) AS txn
FROM (
  SELECT transID,
         CASE WHEN reqDate < DATE '2025-06-01' THEN 'Tet 2025' ELSE 'Tet 2026' END AS season,
         CASE WHEN reqDate < DATE '2025-06-01'
              THEN date_diff('day', date(reqDate), DATE '2025-01-29')
              ELSE date_diff('day', date(reqDate), DATE '2026-02-17') END AS days_to_tet
  FROM payment_air
) t
WHERE days_to_tet BETWEEN -{{ n_after }} AND {{ n_before }}
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

concepts: unique searcher theo departure_date × route, filter departure_date > today
qex_zlp_air_view_23.explanation: View #23. Make clear: "hot" = searcher tăng so baseline nào (7 ngày trước? cùng route?)? Đây là demand chưa chắc supply. Spec: unique searcher theo departure_date × route, filter departure_date > today Note: đầu vào cho alert demand spike
qex_zlp_air_view_23.question: Nhu cầu (search) cho từng ngày bay tương lai — ngày nào sắp "cháy"?

concepts: AVG + phân phối lượt search và COUNT(DISTINCT route) per user_id, search_air, range search_date
qex_zlp_air_view_24.explanation: View #24. Make clear: trong window nào (cả kỳ hay per tuần)? Trả phân phối, đừng chỉ mean (long tail nặng). Spec: AVG + phân phối lượt search và COUNT(DISTINCT route) per user_id, search_air, range search_date Note: 1.62M search / 125K user ≈ 13 lượt/user — xem phân phối, không chỉ mean
qex_zlp_air_view_24.question: 1 user search bao nhiêu lần / bao nhiêu route trước khi quyết?
qex_zlp_air_view_24.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS search_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT route) AS route_cnt
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN search_cnt = 1 THEN '1' WHEN search_cnt <= 5 THEN '2-5'
            WHEN search_cnt <= 20 THEN '6-20' WHEN search_cnt <= 50 THEN '21-50'
            ELSE '>50' END AS search_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS users,
       AVG(route_cnt) AS avg_routes
FROM per_user
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(search_cnt);

concepts: % trip_type (search) vs % UPPER(round_type) (payment), cùng range, cắt theo route
qex_zlp_air_view_25.explanation: View #25. Make clear: so trên cùng range thời gian (search_date vs ngày mua); % theo lượt search vs % theo transaction — 2 đơn vị khác nhau, khai báo rõ là so tỷ trọng, không phải conversion. Spec: % trip_type (search) vs % UPPER(round_type) (payment), cùng range, cắt theo route Note: so sánh tỷ trọng 2 nguồn, chưa cần join user
qex_zlp_air_view_25.question: Search khứ hồi nhiều (17%) nhưng mua khứ hồi ít (6.5%) — gap ở đâu?
qex_zlp_air_view_25.sql:
SELECT 'search' AS src, trip_type AS type_norm,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM search_air
WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'payment', CASE UPPER(round_type) WHEN 'ONEWAY' THEN 'One-way' ELSE 'Round-trip' END,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2)
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 2;

qex_zlp_air_view_26.explanation: View #26. Make clear: cột 97% null → kết quả chỉ đại diện 598 dòng có giá trị, PHẢI nói trước với biz. Hỏi: cần đủ thì suy từ origin/dest (origin nước ngoài = inbound)? Spec: transaction theo in_out_bound, filter flight_type=INTERNATIONAL Note: ⚠ cột 97% null — chỉ dùng trên subset 598 dòng có giá trị, khai báo rõ
qex_zlp_air_view_26.question: Chặng quốc tế: chiều đi hay chiều về nhiều hơn?
qex_zlp_air_view_26.sql:
SELECT in_out_bound, COUNT(transID) AS txn, SUM(amount) AS tpv
FROM payment_air
WHERE flight_type = 'INTERNATIONAL'
  AND in_out_bound IS NOT NULL AND in_out_bound <> ''
GROUP BY 1;

concepts: unique searcher / transaction, grain city (map city→[airport codes])
qex_zlp_air_view_27.explanation: View #27. Make clear: chốt bảng map city→airports với biz trước (SGN=TP.HCM, HAN=Hà Nội, DAD=Đà Nẵng, CXR=Nha Trang, PQC=Phú Quốc, VCA=Cần Thơ, HUI=Huế, VII=Vinh, UIH=Quy Nhơn...); city nào nhiều sân bay phải gom đủ. Spec: unique searcher / transaction, grain city (map city→[airport codes]) Note: cần build bảng map IATA→city trước (SGN/Tân Sơn Nhất...; 1 city nhiều sân bay)
qex_zlp_air_view_27.question: Demand theo thành phố (gộp sân bay)?
qex_zlp_air_view_27.sql:
WITH city_map AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES
    ('SGN','TP.HCM'), ('HAN','Hà Nội'), ('DAD','Đà Nẵng'), ('CXR','Nha Trang'),
    ('PQC','Phú Quốc'), ('VCA','Cần Thơ'), ('HUI','Huế'), ('VII','Vinh'), ('UIH','Quy Nhơn')
    -- bổ sung đủ list trước khi chạy thật
  ) AS t(airport, city)
)
SELECT cd.city AS dest_city, COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS unique_searcher
FROM search_air s
JOIN city_map cd ON cd.airport = s.dest
WHERE s.search_date BETWEEN DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND DATE '{{ to_date }}'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

qex_zlp_air_view_28.explanation: View #28. Make clear: confirm với biz là muốn "cặp thành phố" (SGN↔HAN) — vì view dashboard mặc định tách chiều, số sẽ khác hẳn. Spec: transaction / searcher, grain LEAST‖GREATEST(origin,dest) Note: biến thể của view Route, hỏi biz trước khi đổi grain
qex_zlp_air_view_28.question: Route gộp 2 chiều — cặp thành phố nào lớn nhất?
qex_zlp_air_view_28.sql:
SELECT least(origin, dest) || '-' || greatest(origin, dest) AS city_pair,
       COUNT(transID) AS txn, COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS paying_user
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT {{ top_n }};

concepts: unique buyer / unique searcher, match user_id, window search→pay X ngày (đề xuất 7), range chung
qex_zlp_air_view_29.explanation: View #29. Spec: unique buyer / unique searcher, match user_id, window search→pay X ngày (đề xuất 7), range chung Note: đây là user-level conversion, không phải CR funnel
qex_zlp_air_view_29.question: Bao nhiêu % người search rồi mua?
qex_zlp_air_view_29.sql:
-- Conversion user-level: search → mua trong {{ window_days }} ngày (mặc định 7)
WITH searcher AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(activity_time) AS first_search
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
  GROUP BY 1
),
buyer AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id
  FROM searcher s
  JOIN payment_air p
    ON p.userID = s.user_id
   AND p.reqDate >= s.first_search
   AND p.reqDate <  s.first_search + INTERVAL '{{ window_days }}' DAY
)
SELECT COUNT(*)                                   AS searcher_cnt,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM buyer)               AS buyer_cnt,
       ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM buyer) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_pct
FROM searcher;

concepts: conversion rate per route, match cùng user + cùng route, window X ngày
qex_zlp_air_view_30.explanation: View #30. Spec: conversion rate per route, match cùng user + cùng route, window X ngày Note: output: bảng route × searcher × buyer × CR%, sort CR thấp
qex_zlp_air_view_30.question: Conversion theo route — route nào search nhiều mua ít?
qex_zlp_air_view_30.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT route, user_id, MIN(activity_time) AS first_search
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
b AS (
  SELECT s.route, s.user_id
  FROM s
  JOIN payment_air p
    ON p.userID = s.user_id AND p.route = s.route        -- match cùng user + cùng route
   AND p.reqDate >= s.first_search
   AND p.reqDate <  s.first_search + INTERVAL '{{ window_days }}' DAY
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT s.route,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS searcher,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id) AS buyer,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.user_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id), 2) AS cr_pct
FROM s LEFT JOIN b ON b.route = s.route AND b.user_id = s.user_id
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) >= {{ min_searcher }}   -- đủ mẫu, vd 100
ORDER BY cr_pct ASC;       -- sort tăng dần = route "search nhiều mua ít" lên đầu

qex_zlp_air_view_31.explanation: View #31. Make clear: tính trên grain user×route (chuẩn) hay chỉ user? Đơn vị giờ hay ngày? Spec: median/phân phối (min(reqDate) − min(activity_time)) per user×route Note: time-to-purchase; cắt theo route, booking_window_group
qex_zlp_air_view_31.question: Từ lần search đầu đến lúc mua mất bao lâu?
qex_zlp_air_view_31.sql:
WITH first_search AS (
  SELECT user_id, route, MIN(activity_time) AS first_search
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
matched AS (
  SELECT fs.user_id, fs.route,
         date_diff('second', fs.first_search, MIN(p.reqDate)) / 86400.0 AS days_to_buy
  FROM first_search fs
  JOIN payment_air p
    ON p.userID = fs.user_id AND p.route = fs.route
   AND p.reqDate >= fs.first_search
  GROUP BY 1, 2, fs.first_search
)
SELECT approx_percentile(days_to_buy, 0.5)  AS median_days,
       approx_percentile(days_to_buy, 0.75) AS p75_days,
       approx_percentile(days_to_buy, 0.9)  AS p90_days,
       COUNT(*) AS matched_pairs
FROM matched;

Gồm cả chiều ngược (search SGN-HAN, mua HAN-SGN) — tính là khác hay giống? (đề xuất: chuẩn hóa gộp chiều trước khi so). qex_zlp_air_view_32.question: Khách search xong mua khác route không?
qex_zlp_air_view_32.sql:
WITH buys AS (
  SELECT userID, transID, route, reqDate
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
),
matched AS (
  SELECT b.transID,
         MAX(CASE WHEN s.route = b.route THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_route_searched
  FROM buys b
  JOIN search_air s
    ON s.user_id = b.userID
   AND s.activity_time <  b.reqDate
   AND s.activity_time >= b.reqDate - INTERVAL '{{ window_days }}' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS buys_with_prior_search,
       SUM(1 - same_route_searched) AS bought_diff_route,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(1 - same_route_searched) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_diff_route
FROM matched;

qex_zlp_air_view_33.explanation: View #33. Make clear: so phân phối 2 bucket trên cùng tập user đã match (không phải toàn bộ 2 bảng); loại Unknown bên search. Spec: so phân phối user_search_group (search) vs booking_window_group (payment) trên user đã match Note: cùng bucket structure, payment không có Unknown
qex_zlp_air_view_33.question: Định đặt (day_diff lúc search) vs thực đặt (booking_window lúc mua) lệch nhau không?
qex_zlp_air_view_33.sql:
WITH matched_user AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id
  FROM search_air s JOIN payment_air p ON p.userID = s.user_id
  WHERE s.search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
    AND p.reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND p.reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT 'search_intent' AS src, s.user_search_group AS bucket,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct
FROM search_air s JOIN matched_user m ON m.user_id = s.user_id
WHERE s.search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
  AND s.user_search_group <> 'Unknown'
GROUP BY 2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'pay_behavior', p.booking_window_group,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2)
FROM payment_air p JOIN matched_user m ON m.user_id = p.userID
WHERE p.reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND p.reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY 2;

qex_zlp_air_view_34.question: Danh sách user search nhiều chưa mua (remarketing)?
qex_zlp_air_view_34.sql:
WITH intent AS (
  SELECT user_id, route,
         COUNT(*) AS search_cnt,
         MAX(activity_time) AS last_search
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date >= date_add('day', -{{ lookback_days }}, DATE '{{ as_of_date }}')
    AND search_date <= DATE '{{ as_of_date }}'
  GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING COUNT(*) >= {{ min_search }}
)
SELECT i.user_id, i.route, i.search_cnt, i.last_search
FROM intent i
LEFT JOIN payment_air p
  ON p.userID = i.user_id                      -- thêm: AND p.route = i.route nếu "chưa mua route đó"
 AND p.reqDate >= date_add('day', -{{ lookback_days }}, DATE '{{ as_of_date }}')
WHERE p.transID IS NULL
ORDER BY i.search_cnt DESC;

qex_zlp_air_view_36.question: Khách mua Tết 2025 có quay lại mua Tết 2026 không?
qex_zlp_air_view_36.sql:
WITH tet25 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT userID FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2025-02-01'
),
tet26 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT userID FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'

       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tet26)            AS buyers_tet26,
       COUNT(*)                                AS retained,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tet25), 2) AS retention_pct
FROM tet25 t25 JOIN tet26 t26 ON t26.userID = t25.userID;

qex_zlp_air_view_38.question: RR tháng→tháng của buyer Air?
qex_zlp_air_view_38.sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT date_trunc('month', reqDate) AS ym, userID
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT m0.ym,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m0.userID) AS buyers_m0,
       COUNT(DISTINCT m1.userID) AS retained_m1,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT m1.userID) / COUNT(DISTINCT m0.userID), 2) AS rr_pct
FROM monthly m0
LEFT JOIN monthly m1
  ON m1.userID = m0.userID AND m1.ym = m0.ym + INTERVAL '1' MONTH

qex_zlp_air_view_40.question: Phân tầng khách theo chi tiêu?
qex_zlp_air_view_40.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID, SUM(amount) AS user_tpv, COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY user_tpv) AS decile FROM per_user)
SELECT decile,
       COUNT(*)            AS users,
       SUM(user_tpv)       AS tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(user_tpv) / SUM(SUM(user_tpv)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_tpv,
       CAST(SUM(user_tpv) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(txn) AS aov_in_tier
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC;

qex_zlp_air_view_41.question: Khách mua lặp có hành vi khác khách mua 1 lần?
qex_zlp_air_view_41.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID, COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN u.txn = 1 THEN 'one-time' ELSE 'repeat' END AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.userID)            AS users,
       COUNT(p.transID)                    AS txn,
       CAST(SUM(p.amount) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(p.transID) AS aov,
       approx_percentile(p.booking_window, 0.5) AS median_bw,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(p.round_type) = 'ROUNDTRIP' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_roundtrip,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.flight_type = 'INTERNATIONAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_intl
FROM payment_air p
JOIN per_user u ON u.userID = p.userID
WHERE p.reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND p.reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1;

WITH m AS (
  SELECT appID AS dim,                        -- đổi: route / appUser
         date_trunc('month', reqDate) AS ym,
         COUNT(transID) AS txn, SUM(amount) AS tpv
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT dim, ym, txn, tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * (tpv - LAG(tpv) OVER (PARTITION BY dim ORDER BY ym))
                   / LAG(tpv) OVER (PARTITION BY dim ORDER BY ym), 2) AS tpv_mom_pct
FROM m ORDER BY ym, tpv_mom_pct DESC NULLS LAST;

qex_zlp_air_view_50.explanation: View #50. Make clear: bottom theo transaction tuyệt đối hay theo CR (→ #30)? Loại route quá ít data? Spec: transaction bottom 3, by route Note: underperformer
qex_zlp_air_view_50.question: Tuyến nào bán chậm nhất, có cơ hội tăng không? (E43)
qex_zlp_air_view_50.sql:
SELECT route, COUNT(transID) AS txn, SUM(amount) AS tpv
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(transID) >= {{ min_txn }}     -- vd 10, tránh đuôi route 1-2 đơn
ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT {{ bottom_n }};

concepts: % TPV concentration, top 10 route / top 3 provider / top 5 hãng
qex_zlp_air_view_51.explanation: View #51. Make clear: dimension + N (mặc định: top 10 route / top 3 appUser / top 5 appID)? Theo TPV hay transaction? Spec: % TPV concentration, top 10 route / top 3 provider / top 5 hãng Note: dependency risk
qex_zlp_air_view_51.question: Bao nhiêu % doanh số từ top N tuyến / kênh / hãng? (E45, E60, E89)
qex_zlp_air_view_51.sql:
WITH agg AS (
  SELECT route AS dim, SUM(amount) AS tpv    -- đổi: appUser / appID
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked AS (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tpv DESC) AS rk FROM agg)
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN rk <= {{ top_n }} THEN tpv END) AS tpv_top_n,
       SUM(tpv) AS tpv_total,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rk <= {{ top_n }} THEN tpv END) / SUM(tpv), 2) AS pct_top_n
FROM ranked;

qex_zlp_air_view_52.explanation: View #52. Make clear: #18 là % transaction — đây là % TPV. Bucket chuẩn hay cắt 2 nhóm thô (>30d / <7d)? Spec: % TPV theo booking_window_group Note: gốc #18 mới có % transaction
qex_zlp_air_view_52.question: Khách đặt sớm (>30d) vs sát ngày (<7d) chiếm bao nhiêu % doanh số? (E61–62)
qex_zlp_air_view_52.sql:
SELECT booking_window_group,
       SUM(amount) AS tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(amount) / SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_tpv
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE booking_window_group WHEN 'Same day' THEN 0 WHEN '1-3 days' THEN 1 WHEN '4-7 days' THEN 2
  WHEN '8-14 days' THEN 3 WHEN '15-30 days' THEN 4 WHEN '31-60 days' THEN 5 WHEN '>60 days' THEN 6 END;

qex_zlp_air_view_53.explanation: View #53. Make clear: user có nhiều đơn nhiều bucket → gán theo bucket của đơn đầu tiên (chốt với biz). Spec: % user ≥2 transaction, by booking_window_group Note: loyalty by segment
qex_zlp_air_view_53.question: Nhóm booking window nào có repeat rate cao hơn? (E63)
qex_zlp_air_view_53.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID,
         MIN_BY(booking_window_group, reqDate) AS first_bucket,
         COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT first_bucket,
       COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM per_user GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY CASE first_bucket WHEN 'Same day' THEN 0 WHEN '1-3 days' THEN 1 WHEN '4-7 days' THEN 2
  WHEN '8-14 days' THEN 3 WHEN '15-30 days' THEN 4 WHEN '31-60 days' THEN 5 WHEN '>60 days' THEN 6 END;

qex_zlp_air_view_54.explanation: View #54. Make clear: gán user theo kênh của đơn đầu (như #53). Repeat = ≥2 đơn bất kỳ kênh, hay ≥2 đơn cùng kênh? Spec: % repeat user, by provider Note: loyalty by channel
qex_zlp_air_view_54.question: Kênh nào có repeat rate cao nhất? (E55)
qex_zlp_air_view_54.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID,
         MIN_BY(appUser, reqDate) AS first_channel,
         COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT first_channel, COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM per_user GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY users DESC;

qex_zlp_air_view_55.explanation: View #55. Make clear: "CLV" ở đây = TPV trong coverage — khai báo window, không phải lifetime thật. Spec: TPV per user, by provider Note: khai báo window = coverage
qex_zlp_air_view_55.question: Khách kênh nào chi tiêu nhiều nhất? (E59)
qex_zlp_air_view_55.sql:
SELECT appUser,
       COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS users, SUM(amount) AS tpv,
       CAST(SUM(amount) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS tpv_per_user
FROM payment_air
WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tpv_per_user DESC;

concepts: % cross-market buyer, match user_id, window 7 ngày
qex_zlp_air_view_58.explanation: View #58. Make clear: search_air không có flight_type → phân loại search DOM bằng list sân bay VN (chốt list với biz, như city_map #27). Window match? Hay chỉ cần overlap trong kỳ? Spec: % cross-market buyer, match user_id, window 7 ngày Note: cần map airport→DOM/INTL cho search trước
qex_zlp_air_view_58.question: Khách search nội địa có mua quốc tế không? (E79)
qex_zlp_air_view_58.sql:
WITH vn_airports AS (
  SELECT code FROM (VALUES ('SGN'),('HAN'),('DAD'),('CXR'),('PQC'),('VCA'),('HUI'),('VII'),('UIH')
    -- bổ sung đủ list sân bay VN trước khi chạy thật
  ) AS t(code)
),
dom_search AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(activity_time) AS first_dom_search
  FROM search_air
  WHERE search_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-01' AND DATE '2026-02-28'
    AND origin IN (SELECT code FROM vn_airports)
    AND dest   IN (SELECT code FROM vn_airports)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dom_searchers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.userID) AS bought_intl,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT p.userID) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_cross
FROM dom_search d
LEFT JOIN payment_air p
  ON p.userID = d.user_id
 AND p.flight_type = 'INTERNATIONAL'
 AND p.reqDate >= d.first_dom_search
 AND p.reqDate <  d.first_dom_search + INTERVAL '{{ window_days }}' DAY;

concepts: % buyer 1-đơn có search route ≠ route đã mua, sau ngày mua, window 7 ngày
qex_zlp_air_view_59.explanation: View #59. Make clear: khai báo là proxy intent, không phải nhu cầu chắc chắn. Route "khác" có gộp chiều ngược không (như #32)? Spec: % buyer 1-đơn có search route ≠ route đã mua, sau ngày mua, window 7 ngày Note: proxy intent — khai báo là proxy
qex_zlp_air_view_59.question: Buyer 1 lần có search route khác sau khi mua không? (cross-sell proxy) (E95)
qex_zlp_air_view_59.sql:
WITH one_buyers AS (
  SELECT userID, MIN(route) AS bought_route, MIN(reqDate) AS buy_time
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
  GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(transID) = 1
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM one_buyers) AS one_time_buyers,
       COUNT(DISTINCT b.userID)          AS searched_other_route,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT b.userID) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM one_buyers), 2) AS pct_cross_sell
FROM one_buyers b
JOIN search_air s
  ON s.user_id = b.userID
 AND s.activity_time >  b.buy_time
 AND s.activity_time <  b.buy_time + INTERVAL '{{ window_days }}' DAY
 AND s.route <> b.bought_route;

concepts: repeat rate decile 1 vs overall, TPV per userID
qex_zlp_air_view_60.explanation: View #60. Make clear: VIP = decile 1 theo TPV trong window? So repeat rate (≥2 đơn) VIP vs phần còn lại. Spec: repeat rate decile 1 vs overall, TPV per userID Note: tiering impact
qex_zlp_air_view_60.question: Khách VIP (top 10% spend) có repeat rate cao hơn trung bình bao nhiêu? (E68, E81)
qex_zlp_air_view_60.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID, SUM(amount) AS user_tpv, COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
),
ranked AS (SELECT *, NTILE(10) OVER (ORDER BY user_tpv DESC) AS decile FROM per_user)
SELECT CASE WHEN decile = 1 THEN 'VIP top 10%' ELSE 'Others' END AS segment,
       COUNT(*) AS users,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN txn >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS repeat_pct
FROM ranked GROUP BY 1;

qex_zlp_air_view_61.explanation: View #61. Make clear: ⚠ EnViet gom nhiều hãng → "multi-airline" bị méo (1 appID nhưng nhiều hãng thật). Khai báo grain = appID. Spec: % userID có ≥2 hãng distinct Note: ⚠ EnViet gom nhiều hãng → số bị méo, chốt grain trước
qex_zlp_air_view_61.question: Bao nhiêu % buyer mua từ ≥2 hãng? (E78)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS buyers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN n_app >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_airline,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN n_app >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_multi
FROM (
  SELECT userID, COUNT(DISTINCT appID) AS n_app
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1

concepts: median gap đơn 1 → đơn 2, per userID
qex_zlp_air_view_63.explanation: View #63. Make clear: coverage ~3 tháng → gap bị right-censored (khách sẽ mua lần 2 sau khi hết data không thấy được) — median là cận dưới, phải khai báo. Spec: median gap đơn 1 → đơn 2, per userID Note: coverage ~3 tháng → right-censored, khai báo rõ
qex_zlp_air_view_63.question: Khách quay lại bao lâu mới mua lần 2? (E80)
qex_zlp_air_view_63.sql:
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT userID, reqDate,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY userID ORDER BY reqDate) AS rn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_users,
       approx_percentile(gap_days, 0.5)  AS median_gap_days,
       approx_percentile(gap_days, 0.75) AS p75_gap_days
FROM (
  SELECT o1.userID, date_diff('day', o1.reqDate, o2.reqDate) AS gap_days
  FROM ordered o1
  JOIN ordered o2 ON o2.userID = o1.userID AND o1.rn = 1 AND o2.rn = 2
) t;

concepts: % TPV từ buyer ≥2 đơn, by top route
qex_zlp_air_view_64.explanation: View #64. Make clear: repeat = ≥2 đơn toàn Air (mặc định) hay ≥2 đơn cùng route? Spec: % TPV từ buyer ≥2 đơn, by top route Note: route quality
qex_zlp_air_view_64.question: Top tuyến: bao nhiêu % doanh số từ khách repeat? (E84)
qex_zlp_air_view_64.sql:
WITH per_user AS (
  SELECT userID, COUNT(transID) AS txn
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT p.route,
       SUM(p.amount) AS tpv,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.txn >= 2 THEN p.amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(p.amount), 2) AS pct_tpv_repeat
FROM payment_air p
JOIN per_user u ON u.userID = p.userID
WHERE p.reqDate >= DATE '{{ from_date }}' AND p.reqDate < DATE '{{ to_date }}' + INTERVAL '1' DAY
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY tpv DESC LIMIT {{ top_n }};

concepts: rank segment theo TPV/user × % MoM growth
qex_zlp_air_view_65.explanation: View #65. Make clear: segment theo chiều nào (booking_window_group / flight_type / route / appUser)? Ranking = TPV/user × avg MoM growth là công thức thô — kết quả là bảng xếp hạng để đọc cùng biz, không phải câu trả lời chiến lược. Spec: rank segment theo TPV/user × % MoM growth Note: data ra ranking; "chiến lược" đọc cùng biz
qex_zlp_air_view_65.question: Segment nào nên là target chính? (E99)
qex_zlp_air_view_65.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT booking_window_group AS seg,         -- đổi dimension theo chốt với biz
         date_trunc('month', reqDate) AS ym,
         SUM(amount) AS tpv
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
growth AS (
  SELECT seg, AVG(mom_pct) AS avg_mom_pct
  FROM (
    SELECT seg, ym,
           100.0 * (tpv - LAG(tpv) OVER (PARTITION BY seg ORDER BY ym))
                 / LAG(tpv) OVER (PARTITION BY seg ORDER BY ym) AS mom_pct
    FROM base
  ) t GROUP BY 1
),
val AS (
  SELECT booking_window_group AS seg,
         CAST(SUM(amount) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT userID) AS tpv_per_user
  FROM payment_air
  WHERE reqDate >= DATE '2025-12-01' AND reqDate < DATE '2026-03-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT v.seg, v.tpv_per_user, g.avg_mom_pct
FROM val v LEFT JOIN growth g ON g.seg = v.seg
ORDER BY v.tpv_per_user DESC;

-- Guidance: Số học từ view sẵn, ghi rõ là ước lượng trần/thô, không phải forecast: - E85 thêm X khách repeat → doanh số tăng ≈ X × AOV nhóm repeat (lấy AOV repeat từ #41). - E88 sizing last-minute: SELECT COUNT(transID), SUM(amount) FROM payment_air WHERE booking_window < 7 AND <range reqDate>; — "tối ưu được bao nhiêu" là giả định biz, data chỉ size segment. - E90 top route giảm 10% → tác động ≈ 10% × pct_share route (share từ #14). - E93 invest tuyến X → trần ≈ (searcher − buyer của route) × CR hiện tại × AOV route (lấy từ #30 + #19). --- ## Header khai báo — đính kèm mọi câu SQL xuất ra (dạng comment đầu query) `` Metric: <tên + định nghĩa ngắn, theo ref_zlp_metric_definitions> Đơn vị đếm: <transaction / unique user / TPV / lượt search> Thời gian: <range> theo cột <reqDate / search_date / flight_date / departure_date> Grain: <route tách chiều / city-pair / user / ...> Filter: <domestic only, provider, ...> Match rule (nếu join): <window X ngày, cùng user / cùng user+route, anchor first_search> Assumption: <những gì chưa hỏi được biz và đã tự chọn> ` Rule cuối: khi Trang chạy SQL mà số/lỗi "bất thường" → soát lại query theo thứ tự: (1) literal ngày thiếu DATE '...'` (lỗi varchar), (2) đơn vị đếm, (3) cột thời gian, (4) quên UPPER(round_type), (5) lẫn giai đoạn T12/2024–T1/2025 vào query join, (6) quên loại Unknown, (7) chia nguyên thiếu CAST AS DOUBLE.
